subject: reasoning
question: A, B, C, D, E, F and G are sitting around a circular table facing the centre. F sits to the immediate right of G. B sits third to the left of G. A is the immediate neighbour of D and G. C sits second to the left of B. How many people sit between E and D when counted from the left of D?
solution:
A, B, C, D, E, F and G are sitting around a circular table facing the centre.

 
• F sits to the immediate right of G.
 
• B sits third to the left of G.
 
• A is the immediate neighbour of D and G.
 
• C sits second to the left of B.

The Final Arrangement is,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b99237c5bac2d3202bed903825849ccc09b9cc264cd0b424b09e43ceff782602.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 1"**
